paragraphs: Teradyne, Inc. ("Teradyne") was founded in 1960 and is a leading global provider of automated test equipment and robotics solutions. Teradyne's automated test systems are used to test semiconductors, wireless products, data storage, silicon photonics, and complex electronics systems in many industries including consumer electronics, wireless, automotive, industrial, computing, communications, and aerospace and defense industries. Teradyne's robotics product offerings consist primarily of collaborative robotic arms and autonomous mobile robots used by global manufacturing, logistics and industrial customers to improve quality, increase manufacturing and material handling efficiency while reducing costs. In the first quarter of 2025, Teradyne identified opportunities for operational synergies amongst our production board test, defense and aerospace, and wireless test businesses leading to the creation of the Product Test division as a new segment effective March 2025. Teradyne's automated test equipment and robotics products and services include:
• semiconductor test ("Semiconductor Test") systems; • robotics ("Robotics") products; and

• product test ("Product Test") systems, which include circuit-board test and inspection systems, wireless test systems, photonic integrated circuit ("PIC") test solutions, and defense and aerospace test instrumentation and systems.

The market for our test products is concentrated with a limited number of significant customers accounting for a substantial portion of the purchases of test equipment. A few customers drive sizable demand for our offerings both through direct sales and sales to the customer's supply partners. We expect that sales of our test products will continue to be concentrated with a limited number of major customers for the foreseeable future.

In 2025, our Semiconductor Test segment achieved considerable growth driven by robust demand from Artificial Intelligence ("AI") applications in networking and with vertically integrated producer ("VIP") compute solutions. Memory test revenue remained stable despite a smaller overall market, supported by share gains in high bandwidth memory ("HBM") and DRAM final test applications. The Semiconductor Test segment's strategic shift toward AI-driven semiconductor testing resulted in AI related customer demand driving the majority of our revenue in the second half of 2025. Looking ahead to 2026, we expect AI related customer demand to continue to represent the bulk of our revenues in the first quarter. Our results reflect our focused investments in AI applications and VIP customers, with benefits from these initiatives materializing throughout 2025 and expected to continue in 2026. In the Product Test Group, we also achieved revenue growth in 2025, bolstered primarily by strength in defense and aerospace applications.

In our Robotics segment, the fourth quarter of 2025 represented the third consecutive quarter of sequential revenue growth. During the year, we aimed at strategic partnerships with original equipment manufacturers, systems integrators, and large enterprise accounts, concentrating on high-growth verticals such as ecommerce, logistics, semiconductor, and electronics. At the same time, we also reduced costs through restructuring activities designed to better position the Robotics organization for future success.

On January 29, 2026, we and MultiLane, a leading high-speed input/output ("I/O") test and measurement company, announced an agreement to form a joint venture, MultiLane Test Products ("MLTP"). MLTP is being created to serve the growing demand from the AI Data Center equipment market by accelerating the development of test solutions for critical high speed data connections. Under the agreement, MultiLane will contribute all the assets related to its test and measurement business to the joint venture and we will invest approximately $157 million in exchange for 75% ownership of MLTP. This transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2026 and is subject to customary closing conditions.

On May 31, 2025, we acquired privately held Quantifi Photonics ("Quantifi"), a leader in PIC test solutions for a total purchase price of $127.2 million. This acquisition enables the delivery of scalable PIC test solutions and is included in our Product Test segment. Over time, we also intend to leverage Quantifi's engineering expertise and technology to enhance functionality and create additional differentiation in our Semiconductor Test business, specifically with integration into our UltraFlexplus platform.

On January 31, 2025, we acquired Infineon Technologies AG's ("Infineon") automated test equipment technology and associated development team ("AET") based in Regensburg, Germany for a total purchase price of 17.6 million Euros, equivalent to $18.3 million. AET adds resources and expertise to our company and strengthens the relationship between us and this key customer. AET is included in our Semiconductor Test segment.

Our financial statements are denominated in U.S. dollars. While revenues in our test businesses are predominantly in U.S. dollars, the majority of our Robotics revenue is denominated in foreign currencies. Strengthening of the U.S. dollar would negatively affect Robotics revenue in 2026.

Our corporate strategy is to profitably grow revenue and market share through the introduction of differentiated products targeting expanding markets and customer needs. Our capital allocation plan will continue to be balanced between investing in organic and inorganic growth and returning cash to shareholders through share repurchases and dividends.

We are subject to tariffs and restrictions from the dynamically changing global trade environment. While it is difficult to quantify the exact impact, current trade restrictions are limiting our ability to be competitive, particularly in certain markets, where some competitors are not subjected to the same restrictions. We continue to monitor developments in international trade policy, including potential changes to tariffs, further export controls, and other regulatory measures that could affect our supply chain, cost structure, or market access. For information regarding risks associated with import-export control regulations and similar applicable laws and regulations, see Part II - Item 1A "Risk Factors- Risks Related to Legal and Regulatory Compliance."

We are a Massachusetts corporation incorporated on September 23, 1960. We are subject to the informational requirements of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 ("Exchange Act"). We file periodic reports, proxy statements and other information with the SEC. The SEC maintains an internet site (http://www.sec.gov) that contains reports, proxy and information statements and other information regarding issuers that file documents electronically.

You can access financial and other information, including the charters of our Audit Committee, Compensation Committee and Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee, our Corporate Governance Guidelines and Code of Conduct, by clicking the Investors link on our web site at www.teradyne.com. We make available, free of charge, copies of our filings with the SEC, including our annual reports on Form 10-K, quarterly reports on Form 10-Q, current reports on Form 8-K and amendments to those reports filed or furnished pursuant to Section 13(a) or 15(d) of the Exchange Act through our web site as soon as reasonably practicable after filing such material electronically or otherwise furnishing it to the SEC.

headings: Risks Associated with Teradyne's Markets
Our business is impacted by global and industry-specific economic cycles, which are difficult to predict, and actions we have taken or may take to offset these cycles may not be sufficient.
We are subject to intense competition.
The market for our products is concentrated, and our business depends, in part, on obtaining orders from a few significant customers.
Customer consolidation could affect our operating results.
If we fail to develop new technologies to adapt to our customers' needs or if our customers fail to accept our new products, our revenues will be adversely affected.
Risks Associated with Operating a Global Business
We are subject to risks of operating internationally.
We are subject to risks associated with doing business in China.
Risks Related to Teradyne's Finances
We may not fully realize the benefits of our acquisitions or strategic alliances.
We may incur higher tax rates than we expect and may have exposure to additional international tax liabilities and costs.
We have significant guarantees, indemnification, and customer confidentiality obligations.
We may discontinue or reduce our quarterly cash dividend or share repurchase program.
We have incurred indebtedness and may incur additional indebtedness.
Restrictive covenants in the agreement governing our senior secured revolving credit facility may restrict our ability to pursue business strategies.
We may not be able to pay our debt and other obligations.
Foreign currency exchange rates and fluctuations in those rates may affect the Company's ability to realize projected growth rates in its sales and earnings.
Our stock price has been subject to fluctuations, and will likely continue to be subject to fluctuations, which may be volatile and due to factors beyond our control.
Risks Related to Operations
Our operating results are likely to fluctuate significantly.
If our suppliers do not meet product or delivery requirements, we could have reduced revenues and earnings.
The global supply shortage of electrical components and inflationary cost increases impact our ability to meet customer demand and could adversely affect our business and financial results.
Our operations may be adversely impacted if our outsourced contract manufacturers or service providers fail to perform.
Our business may suffer if we are unable to attract and retain key employees.
Risks Related to Intellectual Property ("IP") and Cybersecurity
Third parties may claim we are infringing their intellectual property and we could suffer significant litigation costs, licensing expenses or be prevented from selling our products.
If we are unable to protect our IP, we may lose a valuable asset or may incur costly litigation to protect our rights.
A breach of our operational or security systems could negatively affect our business and results of operations.
A breach of the security of our products could negatively affect our business and results of operations.
We are exposed to risks related to the use of AI tools by us and others.
Risks Related to Legal and Regulatory Compliance
The implementation of tariffs on our products may have a material impact on our business.

Trade regulations and restrictions impact our ability to manufacture certain products and to sell products to and support certain customers, which may materially adversely affect our sales and results of operations.
We may be subject to product recalls and warranty and product liability claims.
We may incur significant costs of complying with present and future environmental regulations and may incur significant liabilities if we fail to comply with such environmental regulations.
We currently are, and in the future may be, subject to litigation or regulatory proceedings that could have an adverse effect on our business.
We may face risks associated with shareholder activism.
paragraphs: Descriptions of risks associated with our business are set forth below. Some of these risks are highlighted in the following discussion and in Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations, Legal Proceedings, Controls and Procedures and Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk of this Annual Report. The risks described below are not the only risks that we face. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently deem to be immaterial also may materially adversely affect our business, financial condition and/or operating results.

Capital equipment providers in the electronics, semiconductor industries and robotics, such as Teradyne, have, in the past, been negatively impacted by both sudden slowdowns in the global economies and recurring cyclicality within those industries. These cycles, which can be driven by broad changes to Semiconductor buying patterns, or to specific markets within the Semiconductor industry, have resulted in periods of over-supply; a trend we believe will continue to occur. Our business and results of operations depend, in significant part, upon capital expenditures of manufacturers of semiconductors, electronics, and other industrial products, which in turn depend upon the current and anticipated market demand for those products. Disruption or deterioration in global or industry-specific economic conditions may reduce customer purchases of our products, thereby reducing our revenues and earnings. In addition, such adverse changes in economic conditions, and resulting slowdowns in the market for our products, may, among other things, result in increased price competition for our products, increased risk of excess and obsolete inventories, increased risk in the collectability of our accounts receivable from our customers, potential reserves for credit losses and write-offs of accounts receivable, increased risk of restructuring charges, and higher operating costs as a percentage of revenues, which, in each case and together, adversely affect our operating results. We are unable to predict the likely duration, frequency and severity of disruptions in financial markets, credit availability, and adverse economic conditions throughout the world, and we cannot ensure that the level of revenues or new orders for a fiscal quarter will be sustained in subsequent quarters. We have taken actions to address the effects of general economic variability and recurring industry cyclicality, including implementing cost control and reduction measures. We cannot predict whether these measures will be sufficient to offset global or market-specific disruptions that might affect our businesses and we may need to take additional or different measures in the future.

We face significant competition throughout the world in each of our reportable segments. Some of our competitors have substantial financial and other resources to pursue engineering, manufacturing, marketing and distribution of their products. In addition, we are subject to trade regulations imposed by the United States government, which may not impact some of our competitors. We also face competition from emerging Asian companies and internal development at several of our customers. Some of our competitors have introduced or announced new products with certain performance characteristics that may be considered equal or superior to those we currently offer. We expect our competitors to continue to improve the performance of their current products and to introduce new products or new technologies that provide improved cost of ownership and performance characteristics. In addition, the semiconductor industry has experienced significant consolidation over the past several years. Consolidation among our competitors or customers could lead to a changing competitive landscape, which could negatively impact our competitive position. If in the future we are unable to maintain our competitive position, we could experience downward pressure on prices, fewer customer orders, reduced margins, the inability to take advantage of new business opportunities and a loss of market acceptance of our products, any of which could have a material adverse effect on our revenues and results of operations.

The market for our products is concentrated with a limited number of significant global customers accounting for a substantial portion of the purchases of test equipment. In each of the years, 2025, 2024 and 2023, our five largest direct customers in aggregate accounted for 44%, 36% and 32% of consolidated revenues, respectively.

In 2025, we had two customers who specified greater than 10% of our consolidated revenues and one additional customer who directly purchased more than 10% of our consolidated revenues. The two specifying customers drove 12% and 10% of consolidated revenues. The additional direct customer accounted for 19% of consolidated revenues including certain revenues specified by our 10% specifiers.

If we were to lose any of our significant customers, if our products fail to meet changes in customers' demands or if we suffer a material reduction in our customers' purchase orders, our revenue could decline and our operating results and financial condition could be materially and adversely affected. We would have no or limited contractual recourse if our significant customers decided to stop buying and using our products with limited advance notice to us.

paragraphs: Teradyne, Inc. ("Teradyne") 於 1960 年成立，為全球領先的自動測試設備與機械人解決方案供應商。Teradyne 的自動測試系統用於測試半導體、無線產品、資料儲存、矽光晶片與複雜電子系統，應用於消費電子、無線、汽車、工業、計算、通訊與航太防禦等多個產業。Teradyne 的機械人產品組合主要為協作式機械手臂與自動導航機械人，用於全球製造、物流與工業客戶以提升品質、增加製造與物料處理效率並降低成本。在 2025 年第一季，Teradyne 識別出生產板測試、防禦與航太以及無線測試業務之間的運營協同效益，因此成立產品測試部門作為新的應報告分部，自 2025 年 3 月生效。Teradyne 的自動測試設備與機械人產品及服務包括：
• 半導體測試 ("Semiconductor Test") 系統； • 機械人 ("Robotics") 產品；以及
• 產品測試 ("Product Test") 系統，包含電路板測試與檢測系統、無線測試系統、光子整合電路 ("PIC") 測試解決方案，以及防禦與航太測試儀器與系統。
我們測試產品的市場集中於少數重要客戶，這些客戶佔測試設備購買的相當大比例。少數客戶透過直接銷售與銷售至客戶的供應鏈夥伴，驅動我們產品的大量需求。我們預期未來一段時間內，測試產品的銷售仍將集中於少數主要客戶。

在 2025 年，我們的半導體測試分部實現了顯著成長，這是由於人工智慧 ("AI") 應用在網路領域的強勁需求，以及垂直整合製造商 ("VIP") 計算解決方案的推動。記憶體測試收入保持穩定，儘管整體市場規模較小，但受益於高頻寬記憶體 ("HBM") 與 DRAM 最終測試應用的市佔率提升。半導體測試分部的戰略轉向 AI 驅動的半導體測試，使 AI 相關客戶需求成為 2025 年第二季我們收入的主導因素。展望 2026 年，我們預期 AI 相關客戶需求將繼續佔據我們收入的大多數。我們的結果反映我們在 AI 應用與 VIP 客戶上的專注投資，這些計劃的效益在 2025 年逐漸體現，並預期在 2026 年持續。在產品測試部門，我們也在 2025 年實現了收入成長，主要得益於防禦與航太應用的強勢表現。
在我們的機械人部門，2025 年第四季代表連續三個季度的收入成長。在該年度，我們致力於與原始設備製造商、系統整合商與大型企業客戶建立戰略合作夥伴關係，專注於高成長產業，如電商、物流、半導體與電子產品。同時，我們也透過重整活動降低成本，以更好地為未來的成功做準備。

我們於 2026 年 1 月 29 日與 MultiLane，一家領先的高速輸入/輸出 ("I/O") 測試與測量公司，宣佈達成協議，成立合資公司 MultiLane Test Products ("MLTP")。MLTP 的成立旨在應對來自 AI 資料中心設備市場的成長需求，加速開發關鍵高速數據連接的測試解決方案。根據協議，MultiLane 將其測試與測量業務的相關資產貢獻給合資公司，我們則投資約 1.57 億美元，以取得 MLTP 75% 的股權。此交易預計在 2026 年上半年完成，並受常見的交易條件限制。

我們於 2025 年 5 月 31 日收購 privately held 的 Quantifi Photonics ("Quantifi")，這是一家在 PIC 測試解決方案領域的領導者，總購買價格為 1.272 億美元。此收購使我們能夠提供可擴展的 PIC 測試解決方案，並納入我們的產品測試分部。隨著時間推移，我們也計畫利用 Quantifi 的工程專業知識與技術，提升功能並創造更多差異化，特別是在我們的 UltraFlexplus 平台中整合。
於 2025 年 1 月 31 日，本公司取得 Infineon Technologies AG（"Infineon"）位於德國雷根斯堡（Regensburg）的自動測試設備技術及相關開發團隊（"AET"），總購買價格為 17.6 億歐元，相當於 18.3 億美元。AET 增加了本公司資源與專業技術，並強化了本公司與此關鍵客戶的關係。AET 納入本公司半導體測試應報告分部。
本公司財務報表以美元計價。雖然測試業務的營業收入 predominantly 以美元計價，但本公司機械人業務的營業收入大多以外幣計價。美元升值將對 2026 年機械人業務的營業收入產生負面影響。
本公司企業戰略為透過推出差異化產品，以符合擴張中的市場與客戶需求，來實現營收與市佔率的可持續成長。本公司資本配置計畫將持續在投資內生性與外生性成長之間取得平衡，並透過股票回購與股息回饋現金給股東。

本公司受全球貿易環境動態變化的關稅與限制措施影響。雖然難以量化具體影響，但目前的貿易限制措施已限制本公司在某些市場的競爭力，其中一些競爭對手並未受到相同限制。本公司持續監測國際貿易政策的發展，包括可能的關稅變動、進一步出口管制及其他可能影響本公司供應鏈、成本結構或市場准入的規範措施。有關進出口管制規範及其他適用法律與規範的風險資訊，請參閱第二部分 - 第 1A 項 "風險因素-與法律與規範合規相關的風險"。
本公司為麻薩諸塞州公司，於 1960 年 9 月 23 日成立。本公司受 1934 年證券交易所法案（"Exchange Act"）資訊披露要求的約束。本公司會向 SEC 提交定期報告、股東信函及其他資訊。SEC 保有網際網路網站（http://www.sec.gov），其中包含向 SEC 提交文件的發行者之報告、股東信函與資訊聲明及其他資訊。

您可透過本公司網站 www.teradyne.com 的投資人連結，取得財務及其他資訊，包括審計委員會、薪酬委員會與提名與企業治理委員會的章程、本公司企業治理指引與行為準則。本公司會免費提供本公司向 SEC 提交的文件副本，包括年度報告（Form 10-K）、季報（Form 10-Q）、現況報告（Form 8-K）及這些報告的修正案，這些修正案係根據證券交易所法案第 13(a) 或 15(d) 節規定，以電子方式提交或以其他方式提供給 SEC 後，盡可能迅速地透過本公司網站提供。

paragraphs: 本公司為全球自動化測試設備與機械人產品的主要供應商。我們的自動化測試系統用於測試半導體、無線產品、資料儲存、矽光晶片與複雜電子系統，應用於消費電子、無線、汽車、工業、計算、通訊與國防與軍事等多個產業。我們的機械人產品主要為協作式機械手臂與自動導航機械人，用於全球製造、物流與工業客戶，以提升品質與增加製造與物料處理效率，同時降低成本。在2025年第一季，我們發現生產板測試、國防與航空、無線測試業務之間有操作協同效益，因此成立產品測試部門作為新的應報告分部，自2025年3月生效。我們的自動化測試設備與機械人產品與服務包括：
• 半導體測試（"Semiconductor Test"）系統； • 機械人（"Robotics"）產品；以及
• 產品測試（"Product Test"）系統，包含電路板測試與檢測系統、無線測試系統、光子積體電路（"PIC"）測試解決方案，以及國防與航空測試儀器與系統。
我們測試產品的市場集中於少數重要客戶，這些客戶佔測試設備購買的相當大比例。少數客戶透過直接銷售與銷售至客戶的供應鏈夥伴，帶動我們產品的大量需求。我們預期在可預見的未來，測試產品的銷售仍將集中於少數主要客戶。

在2025年，我們的半導體測試分部實現了顯著成長，主要受益於人工智慧（"AI"）應用在網路領域的強勁需求，以及垂直整合製造商（"VIP"）計算解決方案。記憶體測試收入保持穩定，儘管整體市場規模較小，但受益於高頻寬記憶體（"HBM"）與DRAM最終測試應用的市佔率提升。半導體測試分部的戰略轉向人工智慧驅動的半導體測試，使與人工智慧相關的客戶需求成為2025年下半年收入的主要來源。展望2026年，我們預期與人工智慧相關的客戶需求將繼續佔據我們收入的大部分。我們的結果反映我們在人工智慧應用與VIP客戶上的專注投資，這些計劃的效益在2025年逐漸顯現，並預期在2026年持續。在產品測試部門，我們也在2025年實現了收入成長，主要受益於國防與航空應用的強勢表現。
在我們的機械人部門，2025年第四季代表連續第三季的收入成長。在該年度，我們致力於與原始設備製造商、系統整合商與大型企業客戶建立戰略合作關係，專注於高成長的垂直領域，例如電商、物流、半導體與電子產品。同時，我們也透過重整活動降低成本，以更好地為未來的成功做準備。

2026年1月29日，我們與MultiLane，一家領先的高速輸入/輸出（"I/O"）測試與測量公司，宣佈達成協議，成立合資公司MultiLane Test Products（"MLTP"）。MLTP的成立旨在應對人工智慧資料中心設備市場日益增長的需求，加速開發關鍵高速資料連接的測試解決方案。根據協議，MultiLane將其測試與測量業務相關的資產全部投入合資公司，我們則投資約1.57億美元，以取得MLTP 75%的股權。此交易預計在2026年上半年完成，並受常見的交易條件限制。

2025年5月31日，我們收購了 privately held Quantifi Photonics（"Quantifi"），一家在光子積體電路（"PIC"）測試解決方案領域的領導者，總購買價格為1.272億美元。此收購使我們能夠提供可擴展的PIC測試解決方案，並納入我們的產品測試分部。隨著時間推移，我們也計畫利用其工程專業知識與技術，提升功能並創造更多差異化，特別是在我們的半導體測試業務中，與UltraFlexplus平台整合。
於 2025 年 1 月 31 日，本公司取得 Infineon Technologies AG（"Infineon"）位於德國雷根斯堡（Regensburg）的自動測試設備技術及相關開發團隊（"AET"），總購併價格為 17.6 億歐元，相當於 18.3 億美元。AET 增加了本公司資源與專業技術，並強化了本公司與這家關鍵客戶的關係。AET 已納入本公司半導體測試應報告分部。
雖然我們測試業務的營業收入主要以美元計價，但我們機械手臂業務的絕大多數收入是以外幣計價。美元升值已對 2025 年及 2026 年機械手臂業務收入產生負面影響，並將持續產生負面影響。
本公司資本配置計畫將持續聚焦於投資內生與外生成長，並透過股票回購與股息將現金回饋給股東。於 2025 年，本公司完成取得 Quantifi 及 AET，並另外透過 7.021 億美元股票回購及 0.763 億美元股息支付，共回饋 7.784 億美元給股東。

本公司受許多美國及外國法律與法規所規範，包括但不限於關稅、貿易制裁、貿易壁壘、貿易禁運、進出口管制法規、技術轉讓限制及其他法律與法規。此外，美國及外國政府機關已採取，且可能持續採取行政、立法或法規措施，可能影響本公司營運。本公司認為本公司營運在重大層面符合適用的貿易法規。於 2025 年 12 月 31 日財務年度，本公司遵守適用貿易法規所產生的費用並非重大，然而，遵守這些法規已限制本公司在某些地區的競爭能力。未來可能的發展，包括法律與法規或政府政策的變動，可能導致重大費用，且這些費用可能對本公司未來業務或前景產生重大不利影響。
有關進出口管制法規及其他適用法律與法規相關風險資訊，請參閱本 Form 10-K 第二部分 - 第 1A 項 "風險因素-法律與法規合規相關風險"，其於本文件其他處所列載。
本公司已識別下列政策與估計為瞭解本公司業務及營運成果與財務狀況所關鍵。這些估計對本公司營運的影響及相關風險於管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析中討論，其中這些政策影響本公司報告及預期財務結果。有關下列項目之完整會計政策描述，請參閱附註 B："會計政策"，其包含於本年度財務報表附註中。

headings: 與 Teradyne 市場相關的風險
本公司業務受全球及產業特定經濟週期影響，而這些週期難以預測，且本公司所採取或可能採取的措施可能不足以抵消這些週期的影響。
本公司面臨激烈競爭。
本公司產品市場集中，業務在部分程度上依賴獲得來自少數重要客戶的訂單。
客戶集中化可能影響本公司營運成果。
若本公司未能開發新技術以適應客戶需求，或客戶未能接受本公司新產品，將對本公司營業收入產生負面影響。
與經營全球業務相關的風險
本公司面臨國際經營的風險
本公司面臨與在中國從事商業活動相關之風險。
與Teradyne財務相關之風險
本公司可能無法完全實現本公司併購或戰略聯盟之效益。
本公司可能面臨高於預期之稅率，並可能產生額外之國際稅務義務與成本。
本公司負有重大之擔保、賠償及客戶保密義務。
本公司可能停止或減少每季現金股息或股票回購計畫。
本公司已負擔債務，並可能產生額外之債務。

我們可能無法償還債務及其他義務。

本公司股票價格曾經歷波動，並可能持續波動，此波動可能因超出本公司控制範圍的因素所致。
營運相關風險
本公司營運結果可能大幅波動。
若供應商未能符合產品或交貨要求，我們可能導致營收與獲利減少。
全球電氣零組件供應短缺及通貨膨脹所導致的成本增加，會影響我們滿足客戶需求的能力，並可能對本公司業務及財務結果產生不利影響。

本公司業務若無法吸引並留住關鍵員工，可能會受到影響。
與智慧財產權（"IP"）及網路安全相關的風險

若本公司無法保護其智慧財產權，可能會喪失重要資產或需支出高昂費用以維護其權利。
本公司運營或安全系統遭入侵，可能對本公司業務及營運成果產生負面影響。

本公司可能面臨產品回收及保固與產品責任之聲請與索賠。
本公司可能因遵守現行及未來環境規範而產生重大成本，並可能因未遵守環境規範而產生重大賠償責任。
本公司目前可能，且未來可能面臨訴訟或監管程序，可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
本公司可能面臨股東活躍主義相關風險。
paragraphs: 與我們業務相關之風險說明如下。部分風險已在後續討論與分析財務狀況及營運結果、法律程序、控制程序與程序及市場風險之定量與定性披露部分中強調。下列所述風險並非我們唯一面臨之風險。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前我們尚未知悉或認為不重要，但可能對我們之業務、財務狀況及/或營運結果造成重大不利影響。

在電子、半導體產業及機械人產業中，如 Teradyne 之資本設備供應商，過去曾因全球經濟突然減速及產業內反覆出現之週期性現象而受到負面影響。這些週期可能由半導體買方模式之廣泛變動，或特定半導體產業市場之變動所驅動，導致過度供應之時期；我們認為此趨勢將持續發生。我們之業務與營運結果在很大程度上取決於半導體、電子及其他工業產品製造商之資本支出，而這些支出又取決於這些產品之當前及預期市場需求。全球或產業特定經濟條件之幹擾或惡化，可能減少客戶對我們產品之採購，進而減少我們之營收與獲利。此外，這些經濟條件之不利變動及導致我們產品市場減速，可能導致其他方面，例如我們產品之價格競爭增加、過多或過時存貨之風險增加、我們客戶應收帳款之可收回性風險增加、信用損失準備金與應收帳款寫銷之潛在風險、重組費用之風險增加，以及營運成本佔營收百分比增加，所有這些情況均可能對我們之營運結果造成重大不利影響。我們無法預測財務市場、信貸可得性及全球經濟條件之幹擾持續時間、頻率與嚴重程度，且我們無法確保某財務季度之營收或新訂單水平能在後續季度維持。我們已採取行動以應對一般經濟變動性及產業週期性反覆之影響，包括實施成本控制與削減措施。我們無法預測這些措施是否足夠抵消可能影響我們業務之全球或市場特定幹擾，我們可能需要在未來採取更多或不同的措施。

我們在全球各應報告分部均面臨顯著競爭。部分競爭對手擁有足夠的財務及其他資源，以追求其產品之工程、製造、行銷與分銷。此外，我們受美國政府所施加之貿易規範影響，這些規範可能不會影響部分競爭對手。我們也面臨來自亞洲新興企業及部分客戶內部開發之競爭。部分競爭對手已推出或宣佈新產品，其性能特徵可能被視為與我們目前提供之產品相同或更優。我們預期競爭對手會持續改善其現有產品之性能，並推出新產品或新技術，以提供更優之擁有成本與性能特徵。此外，半導體產業在過去幾年經歷了顯著的併購。我們競爭對手或客戶之間的併購可能導致競爭格局改變，進而對我們之競爭地位造成負面影響。若未來我們無法維持我們之競爭地位，我們可能面臨價格壓力下降、客戶訂單減少、邊際率降低、無法利用新業務機會及我們產品之市場接受度下降，任何一種情況都可能對我們之營收與營運結果造成重大不利影響。
我們產品之市場由少數重大全球客戶所集中，這些客戶佔測試設備採購之大部分。在 2025 年、2024 年及 2023 年，我們五大直接客戶合計佔整體營收之 44%、36% 及 32%。
在 2025 年，我們有兩位客戶指定超過我們整體營收 10% 以上，並有一位額外客戶直接採購超過我們整體營收 10% 以上。這兩位指定客戶分別佔整體營收之 12% 與 10%。這位額外直接客戶佔整體營收之 19%，包括我們 10% 指定客戶所指定之部分營收。
若我們失去任何重要客戶，若我們產品未能符合客戶需求之變更，或若我們遭遇客戶訂購量重大減少，我們之營收可能下降，並對我們之營運結果與財務狀況造成重大且不利影響。我們若無或有限之契約救濟途徑，若我們重要客戶決定停止採購與使用我們之產品，且事先未給予我們充分通知。
